title: HELMET Benchmark Assembly and Protocol Packaging

nodes.label:
Design Goals & Principles
Evaluate long-context language models on diverse tasks
Address limited coverage, short contexts, and unreliable metrics

Official Datasets & Source Corpora
Curate from public NLP benchmarks and web documents
Span multi-domain corpora for realistic long contexts

Context Assembly & Synthesis
Construct realistic or synthetic long-context passages
Interleave target information with background text

Task Adaptation Pipeline
Map canonical benchmark tasks into long-context formats
Standardize input formats and instruction specifications

RAG, Citation & Re-ranking Tasks
Passage re-ranking, search citation, and multi-doc QA
Test precise information extraction across large contexts

Four Core Recall Benchmarks
Passkey retrieval, key-value lookup, and needle-in-haystack
Probe basic memory retention and needle extraction

In-Context Learning Demonstrations
Many-shot demonstrations with varied example counts
Evaluate in-context pattern learning over long sequences

Long QA & Narrative Summarization
Book and technical report question answering
Multi-aspect summarization with extensive token spans

Seven Categories · 21 Diverse Tasks
Consolidate 21 tasks across 7 application categories
Balance synthetic retrieval and practical NLP applications

Context Length Control & Scaling
Scale sequence lengths up to 128K tokens
Systematically test degradation across context budgets

Robust Prompting & Shot Standardization
Apply standardized two-shot and zero-shot prompts
Eliminate sensitivity to formatting discrepancies

Task-Specific Evaluation Protocols
Reference-based metrics, exact match, and model judges
Align metrics to downstream human-level quality

HELMET Standardized Suite Freeze
Unified benchmark evaluation suite packaging
Reproducible harness for open and proprietary LCLMs
